 Bolex Reporter, Volume 14
 1964
 Volume 14, Number 1
 Articles: "So You Want to Make Movies?", Geza De Rosner; "Successful Travel and Vacation Films", Jeanne Porterfield, Lisa Chickering and George W. Perkins II; "Expedition Movie Making", Major Mike Banks; "Down Under", Arnold R. Woodgate, ARPS; "Wild Flowers on Film", Eldon Robbins; "Wildlife Movies", Carl E. Scott and Jack Swedberg; "Insects in Their Natural Habitat", Peter T. Fetko; "Bolex in the Insect World", Charles J. Long; "Birding with Bolex", J. Donald Sutherland; "Exposure Automation", Ernst Wildi
 This issue features several articles on nature and wildlife filming. There is also an extensive article discussing the automatic diaphragm on the new Vario Switar EE lenses. The following products are introduced or reviewed: The 18-5 Auto Projector; K2, S1 and P3 cameras; Vario Switar 36EE and 86EE lenses; Macro-Switar 50mm lens; Bolex H lightmeter; Pan Cinor 85-2 Zoom Lens; Angenieux 120 w/ finder; Built-in base on new model H cameras; Aluminum Carrying Case.
 36 pages
 1964-1965
 Volume 14, Number 2
 Articles: "So, You Want to Make Movies! Part II", Geza De Rosner; "35mm to 8mm - Closer Than You Think", Myron A. Matzkin; "Shooting Rhino", Robert Citron; "Free Lancing in Alaska", Harold Eastwood; "Effective 8mm Projection", Ernst Wildi; "Close-Up Filming", Ted Browne; "My Bolex Feeds Eight Hungry Mouths", William Stockdale
 The 'Technical Corner' of this issue explains lens mounts and discusses the interchangeability of Kern lenses for use with all models of Bolex cameras
